name: Cherry Blossom Starter House
description: A starter house in pink planks and dark trim with a red brick roof and a front balcony. Two joined sections give you a main room plus an upper floor. Simple blocks, simple shape, quick to copy. A solid first base for a new survival world.

subBuilds.description: Replace red wool with cherry logs.
Come to the front and create the same design.
Come to the first floor and build it.
Place a pickaxe and a sword in the item frame.
Come to the ground floor and build this room.
